item.title: 您现在可以直接在 Gemini 中生成、预览和编辑文档、PDF、演示文稿、电子表格等。 / You can now generate, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and more directly in Gemini.
item.description: Generate, edit, and preview PDFs or Docs directly in Gemini. Use the new full-screen editor to refine your files today. See what's new in Gemini.（Google Gemini）

item.title: OpenRouter 实测 Claude Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku 5.5 该选哪个 / Claude Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku: Which Should You Use?
item.description: Use Claude Sonnet 5.5 as your default, Haiku 5.5 for high-volume and sub-agent work, and Opus 5.5 for long tasks where a mistake is costly. We compared the three on price, benchmarks, 11 coding tasks with hidden tests and a Claude Code bug fix. All three passed everything, so the difference was cost.（OpenRouter Blog）

item.title: OpenAI 更新 Model Spec，围绕五项核心价值观重组模型行为准则 / An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
item.description: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.（OpenAI News）

item.title: 未来属于每个人：Meta 和 CNIB 合作支持盲人、聋哑人或视力低下的加拿大人 / The Future Is for Everyone: Meta and CNIB Partner to Support Canadians Who Are Blind, Deafblind or Have Low Vision
item.description: We believe the future is for everyone. That’s why Meta is partnering with CNIB – a non-profit founded in 1918 that empowers Canadians impacted by blindness to live their dreams – to help bring the benefit of AI glasses to more Canadians who are blind, Deafblind or have low vision. The goal of the partnership is to help people who are blind, Deafblind or have low vision explore the possibilities of AI wearable technology, and draw on the knowledge, expertise and lived experience of the community （Meta AI / Muse Newsroom）

item.title: Gemini Notebook 提供数百本教科书，帮助学生学习更多内容。 / Gemini Notebook makes hundreds of textbooks available to help students learn even more.
item.description: Add textbooks from OpenStax and S Chand to Google Gemini Notebook. Generate custom study guides and quizzes now. See the available catalog.（Gemini Notebook Blog）

item.title: 托管深度代理 v0.10：浏览器使用和异步子代理 / Managed Deep Agents v0.10: Browser Use and Async Subagents
item.description: Managed Deep Agents v0.10 adds browser use, so agents can work on sites with no API and hand you the window to sign in, and async subagents for background work.（LangChain Blog）

item.title: OpenRouter 用真实会话数据拆解 Claude Code 成本：Opus 5.5 短会话中位数 $0.31 / How Much Does Claude Code Cost? Real Session Costs by Model
item.description: Claude Code is free to install, and what you pay for is the model it calls. We publish the median cost of real Claude Code sessions on OpenRouter by model and session length. This post shows those costs, why the first request costs the most, what a month of use comes to, and how to lower the bill.（OpenRouter Blog）

item.title: 404 Media 起底 Proton 内部 AI 转型之争：CEO Andy Yen 强推 AI 引发恐惧文化 / Manifestos, Fear, and ‘Loser Thinking’: Inside Proton’s AI Reckoning
item.description: 404 Media 采访九名现任与离职 Proton 员工并查阅内部文件，报道 CEO Andy Yen 强推 AI 转型引发的内部冲突。10 月公司 90% 代码由 AI 编写，多使用 Anthropic 的 Claude；Yen 称今年是最后一年招聘工程师，并宣布将以可能决定去留的重新面试评估员工 AI 使用情况。（404 Media（RSS））

item.title: Google 与 Reddit 同日股价大跌，AI 搜索变现困境冲击开放网络 / What Google and Reddit's bad days have in common
item.description: Casey Newton 分析 Google 与 Reddit 同日遭遇的股市重挫：Alphabet 股价跌 12.6%，蒸发约 $5000 亿市值，为史上第二大单日市值缩水；高管承认 AI Mode 变现能力低于传统搜索，尽管 AI Mode 月用户约 10 亿、搜索收入仍增长 12% 至 $633.5 亿。（Platformer（热点 RSS））

item.title: 托管深度代理中的浏览器使用 / Browser Use in Managed Deep Agents
item.description: Managed Deep Agents now runs a browser for your agent, with tools tuned for context-efficient browser use and a handoff so you can sign in yourself.（LangChain Blog）

item.title: How to use Gemini to update your resume
item.description: Turn raw notes into high-impact, ATS-friendly resume bullets using Gemini. Follow these four steps to polish your professional profile. Get the details.（Google Gemini）

item.title: OpenAI 详解如何检测前沿模型失准行为 / How we detect frontier model misalignment
item.description: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.（OpenAI News）

item.title: Andy Jassy 称 AWS 将成为万亿美元营收业务，2026 年资本开支约 2200 亿美元 / AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
item.description: 亚马逊财报电话会上，CEO Andy Jassy 重申 AWS 可在未来五到十年成为万亿美元年营收业务，预计 2026 年现金资本开支约 2200 亿美元，其中大部分投向 AWS，2027 年还将大幅增加。AWS 当季营收同比增长 39%，年化营收运行率达 1840 亿美元，Jassy 预测 2027 和 2028 年增速均可超 40%；财报后盘后交易中亚马逊股价下跌约 6%。（TechCrunch：AI（RSS））

item.title: Anthropic S-1 文件解读：财务表现强劲但增长放缓存隐忧 / Anthropic’s financials are surprisingly strong
item.description: 作者通读 Anthropic 公开版 S-1 文件，认为公司财务状况好于预期：2026 年第二季度收入从一季度的 47 亿美元增至 116 亿美元，并录得首个运营利润，截至 6 月底现金储备仅次于 Google 和 Berkshire Hathaway。（Timothy B. Lee：Understanding AI（RSS））

item.title: SemiAnalysis 分析师解读 Anthropic S-1 招股书背后的 AI 经济账 / Anthropic is asking Wall Street to believe in AGI
item.description: The Verge Decoder 节目邀请 SemiAnalysis 分析师 Joey Brookhart 解读 Anthropic 提交的 S-1 招股书，公司拟在纳斯达克上市，估值区间 1.5 万亿至 2 万亿美元。（The Verge：AI（RSS））
